mustFix.title: The candidate's prose keeps OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING as leftover-design while its authoritative projection is empty
mustFix.finding: basedOn.fixtureCorpusV9.role and obligations[4].reason each say leftover-design of OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING remains until a paired remasurement on sdk leftover-join.v6. obligations[3].existingGate says 'leftover remaining after paired remasurement on sdk leftover-join.v9'. These are present-tense remainder claims. They contradict obligations[3].leftoverDesign false, summary.leftoverDesign [], authorityClaim, purpose, registerRowNote, leftoverDesignOpenStanding, and doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone, all of which say sdk leftover-join.v9 plus this G20 remasurement make the authoring claim stale on DR-G20.
mustFix.whyItIsAMustFix: The sole purpose of this successor is to change the G20 remainder after the paired sdk leftover-join.v9 remasurement. A recordable leftover join cannot simultaneously project no leftover-design and say the same obligation remains. The execution obligation remains qualification, but that is not leftover-design of fixture authoring.
mustFix.repair: Retire the carried sdk-v6 pairing language and the phrase 'leftover remaining'. State that the paired remasurement has occurred and OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING is stale as an authoring claim on DR-G20, while preserving G20 execution as qualification and preserving OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED on sdk leftover-join.v9 / DR-125.

observationsNotFindings: The remaining sdk leftover-join.v6 references in negative doesNot clauses and in predecessor history do not themselves remasure v6 and are not findings; the charged current-rationale leaf is narrower.
The candidate does not steal OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED, does not remasure sdk leftover-join.v9, does not SATISFY DR-117, DR-125, or DR-G20, and does not invent a platform or SDK API.
reviewSummary: REJECT. The mechanical pins and structural empty-leftover projection are sound, but carried prose still leaves G20 FX authoring open, two lineage leaves still make v9 current after D-328, the SDK-reserved rationale points at superseded v6, and the v10 finding ledger is stale against its own cited paths.
